parts:

Yu Chuan

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Affymetrix Exon Array 1.0ST CDF file
parts:
Hi,

first please be more specific, because there are various kinds of
Affymetrix exon arrays. It's only from your other message that one
can guess you mean the Human exon array HuEx-1_0-st-v2:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/huex-1-0-st-v2?hl=en

To the best of my knowledge what you find on/from that page, is what
is most recent. If someone else has created updated CDF files, please
contribute/share them - we can host them if you don't have webspace.

You find some links to some external repositories for custom made CDFs
on the "overview" page:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/overview

They might be of use.

There are some guidelines on how to create your own, if you want to
take that path. If you do, please help us update the documentation
(if you find it unclear).

/Henrik
